notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (Shopify default) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, so tier (a) HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) was used throughout, no Chrome tab needed. TREE: built from the full English mega-menu embedded in https://www.merci-merci.com/en homepage HTML (SidebarMenu__Nav, header sections The Bed / The Bath / The Table / Women's Fashion / Men's Fashion / Children / Deco & lifestyle / Beauty / Furniture / About), cross-checked against /sitemap_collections_1.xml (330+ collection URLs, incl. many color/size/limited-edition variant collections that were treated as non-canonical duplicates and skipped). Every recorded leaf's canonical tag and h1 were checked and matched the requested slug. QTY: primary method = Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (counts products.json array length, page=2 checked when count hit 250 - never happened here). Four nav handles (bath-towels, bathrobes, child-household-linens, storage-boxes) return an empty products.json array despite being real, canonical, populated pages (custom/virtual collection resolution on this storefront) - for these, qty was obtained by Playwright-rendering the page, scrolling the full infinite-scroll grid, and counting unique /products/ links, after excluding 5 items (a bandana, a candle, a duvet set, a cot bumper, a gift card) that were confirmed to appear identically and out-of-grid-order on every one of these 4 pages as a fixed sitewide promo block, not real collection members. storage-boxes' cleaned count (33) was cross-validated exactly against products.json under its French alias handle 'boites-rangement' (same canonical page, 33 products) - HIGH confidence. bath-towels (46) and bathrobes (17) and child-household-linens (8) could not be cross-validated against an exact alias and are MEDIUM confidence. EXCLUDED: all Women's/Men's/Children's Fashion, Beauty, Watches/Jewelry, Kitchen & Dining tableware/cutlery/cookware (Table section minus linens), Lighting (lampes/suspensions/appliques), Wall Decor (posters, mirrors, clocks), Decorative Accessories (vases, candles), Books/Stationery/Gadgets, Furniture proper (sofas, chairs, tables, wardrobes) - these belong to other category tasks. Also excluded as non-textile/non-storage after inspection: 'accessoires-salle-de-bain' (45 products, all porcelain hooks/soap dishes/toothbrush holders/trays - decorative bathroom accessories, not storage or textile), 'paniers' (14 products, all shopping nets/tote bags/kraft bags despite French name meaning baskets - personal carrying bags, not home storage), 'trousses-et-accessoires' (toiletry bags - fashion/personal carrying, not home storage), 'entretien-rangement' (111-product mixed cleaning+gardening+storage-box collection with no dedicated storage-only sub-URL to isolate an exact qty from - excluded per no-aggregation/no-estimation rule; its genuine storage-box items are the same ones already captured in the separate 'storage-boxes' collection), 'les-accessoires-merci' (85 products, all souvenir gift items - keychains, magnets, stickers, pins - not home textile/storage), 'linge-de-maison-merci' (387 products - a shop-all aggregate of the same bed/bath/table linens already captured individually under their own subcategory URLs, treated as a View-All page and skipped), 'dessous-de-verre-en-lin' (linen coasters - Kitchen & Dining item despite linen material), 'cabas-en-lin-lave' (linen shopping tote - fashion bag). No block encountered; status=ok.
